title: A Primer of the Short Sickle
summary: Teaches an untrained beginner the first pull cuts, hooks and guards of the short sickle using body strength alone.

title: Field-Hand's Drill-Book of the Hooked Blade
summary: Drills farm workers in turning the sickle they carry daily into a close defense, with no qi required.

title: Handbook of Stubble-Field Fighting
summary: Shows beginners how to cut low, hook limbs and pivot on rough open ground with the curved harvest blade.

title: Workbook of the Curved Harvest Blade
summary: Sets out eight graded exercises in binding, sweeping and hooking for students whose muscles have begun to harden.

title: Beginner's Canon of Hook and Haft
summary: Covers grip, haft use and the hooking snap for students with tempered tendons who still use no qi.

title: Primer for the Qi-Warmed Sickle
summary: Introduces newly awakened students to threading a little circulating qi along the sickle's edge and hook.

title: Handbook of the Sheaf-Cutter's Guard
summary: Teaches seven defensive and hooking motions drawn from cutting grain, now backed by a breath of qi.

title: Drill-Book of Pull-Cuts and Hooks
summary: Gives circulating students eight drills joining the pull cut and the hook, each lightly carried by qi.

title: A Workbook on the Toothed Sickle Edge
summary: Explains how to saw, snag and drag with a toothed sickle edge while keeping qi use minimal.

title: Treatise on Close Work with the Curved Blade
summary: Treats seven close-quarters motions for the curved blade, built on easy qi circulation through the arms.
